pull.title: test: remove unused nodes and restarts from wallet tests
pull.body:
Some wallet functional tests start or restart nodes they never use:

- `wallet_basic.py`: node 3 hasn't been used since the `resendwallettransactions` check was removed in 2019 (f5162458cd), but the test still starts, stops and restarts it. Without it, the sync calls no longer need `self.nodes[0:3]`.

- `wallet_signrawtransactionwithwallet.py` and `wallet_derivehdkey.py` each start a second node that is never used.

- `wallet_sendall.py` restarts node 0 and reloads its wallets twice in a row with the same arguments.

No coverage changes. Each test runs a bit faster, about 0.2–0.4 s per test locally.

events.message:
test: remove unused node from wallet_basic

Node 3 was last used by the resendwallettransactions check, which was
removed together with the RPC in f5162458cd. Since then the test only
starts, connects and syncs it, and never checks anything on it.

Drop it, and use the default sync now that all nodes take part, instead
of passing self.nodes[0:3].

test: use one node in signrawtransactionwithwallet and derivehdkey

Neither test uses its second node. wallet_signrawtransactionwithwallet
stopped using node1 when the key-based cases moved to
rpc_signrawtransactionwithkey.py in 0ee43d13e9, and wallet_derivehdkey
never used it.

test: remove duplicate restart from wallet_sendall

sendall_fails_when_bump_fees_exceed_maxtxfee restarts node 0 and
reloads the wallets twice in a row with the same arguments. The second
restart does nothing.
